recent.text: The #NJDevils have placed F Anthony Mantha (throat) on LTIR, retro to 11/7. F Riley Tufte has been loaned to Utica (AHL), and the team has recalled F Lenni Hameenaho and F Stefan Noesen from Utica.

recent.text: Mantha's injury is retroactive to Nov. 7, which is important when counting the number of days. A player on LTIR has to miss at least 10 games and 24 calendar days.
